description: This file defines the TipsAdapter class for an Android application, which manages and displays a list of tips or error messages based on different exceptions encountered within the app. It extends RecyclerView.Adapter and handles binding tips to views, as well as generating tips dynamically from a list of Throwable objects.

classes.name: TipsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for RecyclerView that displays a list of tips or error messages based on different exceptions encountered during app operation.

methods.name: TipsAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a listener for action button clicks.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TipsViewHolder by inflating the item_tip layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a TipsModel to the TipsViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tips in the list.

methods.name: setThrowables
methods.description: Populates the tips list based on a list of Throwable objects, adding appropriate tips for each exception type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a tip with specified string resource ID and optional intent to the tips list.
